author: AllRatesToday
description:
Central Bank Exchange Rates
	

Official exchange rates published by 123 central banks and 58 tax and customs authorities, as one CSV per institution: 16,427,494 rows, the oldest series from 1914, latest table in this mirror 2026-11-22. Collected and published by AllRatesToday, refreshed daily from the same pipeline as the live API.
Every row is the figure the institution itself published for that date: the ECB euro reference rate, the Federal Reserve H.10 table, the Bank of England… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AllRatesToday/central-bank-exchange-rates.
